snippet.title: Sanguine - Early Access Release Trailer
snippet.description:
SANGUINE – Early Access Now Available on Steam October 24th
Created by Ryan Berg | Music by Jack Jack DeBondt

In this modern take on classic survival horror, you’ll play as Kris, a woman with no memory trapped in a collapsing town consumed by parasitic horrors known as the Bloods.
Uncover the dark experiments of the AlTran Corporation, piece together what really happened, and fight to stay human—before the Bloods claim you too.

-Experience classic fixed-camera or modern over-the-shoulder gameplay modes
-Solve intricate puzzles and manage limited resources
-Uncover the truth behind the GATE Project and the outbreak
-Immerse yourself in an atmospheric 90s-inspired world with PSX visuals
-Succumb to the will of the Bloods with an original haunting soundtrack

🎮 Demo available now on Steam | Early Access launches October 24th
👉 https://store.steampowered.com/app/2825080/Sanguine/
🌐 Official Website: https://www.sanguinegame.com
💬 Join the community: https://discord.gg/25DYxMCn97
🐦 Follow for updates: @SanguineGame

Early Access includes over half of Kris’s campaign, with new content and chapters arriving in free updates leading to the full release in 2027!
